tools.name: calculate_margin
tools.description: Manifeste e-commerce margin calculator. From a selling price and a delivered cost, returns a GO / RISKY / NO-GO verdict, what the seller really keeps per sale after VAT, platform fees (TikTok Shop, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, own store/Shopify), affiliate commission, payment fees, returns and social contrib

tools.name: compare_channels
tools.description: Compares the same product (price, delivered cost) across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Etsy, eBay and an own online store in one country, with the verdict and net kept per sale on each channel.
